hypothesis: Typed exact certificate languages can sometimes eliminate a live boundary where ordinary CNF variable elimination expands; any such success is family/instance evidence only unless arbitrary-CNF polynomial discovery, representation and runtime are formally proved.
obfuscation: Every structured instance receives deterministic variable permutation, literal/clause order shuffle and harmless duplicate-clause noise before the portfolio sees it. Evaluator retains the family label; portfolio does not.

proof_requirements.GF2_AFFINE: Only accept a complete XOR-clause block whose truth table exactly matches one affine parity equation; Gaussian elimination must derive 0=1 for UNSAT.
proof_requirements.COUNTING_HALL: Only accept an exact syntactic pigeon-to-hole encoding reconstructed from clauses after variable renaming; refutation requires m>n with every pigeon having an at-least-one-hole clause and every hole pairwise at-most-one occupancy clauses.
proof_requirements.HORN_CLOSURE: Only accept clauses with at most one positive literal and derive contradiction by exact forward chaining/unit closure.
proof_requirements.DP_FALLBACK: Exact Davis-Putnam variable elimination with tautology deletion, subsumption and an immutable representation cap; cap exhaustion returns OPEN_RESOURCE_LIMIT, never SAT/UNSAT.

gates.criterion: 100% of returned SAT/UNSAT terminals match evaluator truth; no false theorem terminal.
>=75% of TSEITIN_PARITY + PIGEONHOLE + HORN_PEBBLING cases terminate through their exact typed language rather than DP.
100% paired variants of each structured base size agree in terminal truth and typed-language class.
Every typed success must end with final_live_boundary < initial_live_boundary and a replayable certificate.
At least one finite holdout case must be solved by a typed language while bounded DP reaches an immutable representation/resource cap on the same CNF.
Any unresolved RANDOM_3CNF_UNSAT or capped DP case remains OPEN/UNKNOWN and is never negative evidence.
Portfolio APIs receive only canonical CNF plus accounting caps; family labels remain evaluator-only.
Cannot PASS from finite experiments. Remains OPEN unless a separate formal arbitrary-CNF polynomial proof is supplied.
